INSERT INTO
post_view_hourly_stat (stat_hour, post_id, view_count) page_view_hourly_stat (stat_hour, page_path, view_count)
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS DATETIME),
post_id page_path , COUNT(*) FROM
post_view_log page_view_log
WHERE visited_at >= #{bucketStart} AND visited_at < #{bucketEnd} GROUP BY 1, 2

INSERT INTO
post_view_country_daily_stat (stat_date, post_id, country, view_count) page_view_country_daily_stat (stat_date, page_path, country, view_count)
SELECT DATE(visited_at),
post_id page_path , COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知'), COUNT(*) FROM
post_view_log page_view_log
WHERE visited_at >= #{bucketStart} AND visited_at < #{bucketEnd} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + VALUES(view_count)
